title: Risk-Controlled Test-Time Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Models
title_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型的风险可控测试时适应
abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented vision-language-action (VLA) models enable efficient test-time adaptation by leveraging expert demonstrations as additional context without updating model parameters. However, even when retrieved demonstrations are relevant to the current task, the VLA may fail to effectively utilize the retrieved information, ultimately leading to task failure. To address this challenge, we propose R2-VLA, a risk-controlled retrieval-augmented VLA framework that enables reliable test-time adaptation by satisfying a user-specified task success rate requirement with minimal expert assistance. Specifically, R2-VLA learns an uncertainty predictor that estimates the uncertainty of the VLA's predicted actions given the retrieved demonstrations, guiding when to act autonomously or request expert assistance. We further introduce a task-level risk-control procedure that calibrates the uncertainty threshold to satisfy a user-specified task-failure risk requirement. Moreover, R2-VLA continually incorporates expert corrections into its retrieval memory to improve future adaptation while preserving the prescribed task-level risk guarantee. Experiments across three VLA backbones and four LIBERO benchmark suites demonstrate that R2-VLA improves average task success by 9.2--11.2 percentage points, achieving the desired target with fewer expert requests. These results highlight the effectiveness of connecting the usefulness of retrieved demonstrations with task-level risk control to enable successful robotic manipulation.
abstract_zh: 检索增强的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型可将专家示范作为额外上下文，在不更新模型参数的情况下实现高效的测试时适应。然而，即使检索到的示范与当前任务相关，模型也可能无法有效利用这些信息，导致任务失败。为此，论文提出 R2-VLA，旨在以尽可能少的专家协助达到用户指定的任务成功率。R2-VLA 学习一个不确定性预测器，估计模型在给定检索示范时所预测动作的不确定性，据此决定自主执行还是请求专家协助。该框架还在任务层面校准不确定性阈值，以满足用户设定的任务失败风险上限，并持续将专家纠正纳入检索记忆，在维持既定风险保证的同时改善后续适应。在 3 种 VLA 骨干模型和 4 组 LIBERO 基准任务上的实验表明，R2-VLA 将平均任务成功率提高了 9.2–11.2 个百分点，并以更少的专家请求达到目标成功率。
key_points_zh: 检索示范与任务相关，不代表 VLA 能有效利用它；R2-VLA 因此根据动作预测的不确定性决定自主执行还是请求专家协助。
在任务层面校准不确定性阈值，使整项任务的失败风险满足用户设定的上限。
持续将专家纠正加入检索记忆，在不更新 VLA 参数的情况下改善后续适应，并维持既定风险保证。
在 3 种 VLA 骨干模型和 4 组 LIBERO 基准任务上，平均任务成功率提高 9.2–11.2 个百分点，且达到目标所需的专家请求更少。
